Based on the screenshot provided, here is a precise description of the desktop application (OpenAI Codex):

**(1) Left Sidebar Rows**
Under the **Projects** section:
*   "No projects"

Under the **Chats** section:
*   "No chats"

Other sidebar items include: "+ New chat", "Repository", "Pull requests", "Plugins", "Workflows", "Terminal", "Browser", and "Settings".

**(2) Main Transcript Area Content**
The main area displays a welcome screen with the text:
*   **"What should we work on?"**
*   **"Start a new chat or open one from the sidebar."**

Below this is a **"Sign in to get started"** card containing:
*   **"Sign in to start using Codex."**
*   Button: **"Sign in with ChatGPT"**
*   Button: **"Use device code"**
*   Button: **"Use API key"**
*   Button: **"Use Amazon Bedrock (Experimental)"**

There are no user message transcripts visible.

**(3) Status Bar / Toast Message**
At the very bottom left of the sidebar, the status text reads:
*   **"App-server online"** (preceded by a green dot icon).

**(4) Composer State**
The input area at the bottom shows:
*   **Agent:** A card labeled **"Review Agent"** with the description **"Find actionable bugs in code changes"** and a **"Built-in"** tag.
*   **Input Field:** Contains the text **"/review"** followed by a cursor.
*   **Mode Dropdown:** Set to **"Ask for approval"**.
*   **Model Selector:** Set to **"GPT-5.6-Sol"**.
*   **Settings:** Dropdowns set to **"Low"** and **"Standard"**.
*   **Action:** A blue circular submit button with an upward arrow icon.
